reviews.t: Oh my goodness these tweezers are fantastic. I have been tweeting for around 24 yrs ...
reviews.x: Oh my goodness these tweezers are fantastic. I have been tweeting for around 24 yrs and have never had a set as nice as these. I have the curse of super thick and coarse eyebrows. This requires tweeting every other day. These tweezers are super sharp and where able to get those little hairs most can not get for days! I will not waste my money or time on any other tweezers again.... I was not paid to given anything for this review. I add that because I hate when you read something and get excited

reviews.t: Sassy package and a great price point.
reviews.x: I kinda think the title says it. The tweezers tweeze. I mean, I haven’t plucked every hair from my body, but I’ve used each tweezer on various types of hairs, a nail shard, and some weird thing that was hopefully not the plague, and they worked exactly in the way one would expect tweezers to work. Perfection.

I haven't had the set 6 hours yet and I already love them! The three easily distinct colors are silver flecked baby blue for the flat tip, a pale silver flecked lavender for the pointy tip, and a silver flecked baby pink for the slant tip. They come in a super cute deep blue shiny pouch with a pink kitty on the flap that says "show & tell" that makes them virtually impossible to lose and I've lost 3 store bought pairs in the past 2 years. They're a versatile set that I can use at home or

These are very inexpensive but fortunately not cheap. I have been a Tweezerman fan for a a long time but when it came time to buy a cheap backup pair for my gf I wanted to try something different. I can't speak on long term durability I'm fairly impressed with their performance being new and sharp.

Perfect set for perfect brows etc. the 3 end shapes let you use the right tool for the job and for the price I thought maybe not top quality--but was so happy to find great quality tweezers - strong and edged well. 👍😎

I've bought a few pairs of tweezers from Target, Walmart etc. And all of them had a gap when you closed the tweezers which prevented you from being able to actually use them to tweeze eyebrows. Finally I found these! It comes with 3 different types and they don't have that gap! They close firmly and easily grab the hair to tweeze and shape eyebrows.

reviews.t: I used all 3 and love them all and I am extremely loyal to my tweezerman that is upwards of 20 years old!
reviews.x: These are a gift for my daughter (who keeps stealing mine) who won't receive them for a couple days but I wand them for myself.  I used all 3 and love them all and I am extremely loyal to my one pair (that my daughter will probably never steal again because these are so great.
I LOVE this set. I just received them and they are better than the pair I bought in store for twice as much. They arrived 5 days early too!
I totally recommend this product, I love it!! Also the service is awesome, they're so kind and care about your opinion!

reviews.t: Just Go ahead and Buy them already!!
reviews.x: Seriously- buy these!  I purchased when they were $6.95.  Best tweezers I've ever had.  I'm an addict... meaning I pluck my eyebrows multiple times a day with a magnification mirror.  Never had a pouch for my tweezers either- boy I was missing out.  Can't lose them in this and pouch is nice sturdy and stylish.  I like having 3 different types of tweezers- flat slanted and pointed for ingrown hairs which I have a lot of.  Okay I'm done- buy these!  They're pretty too :)

reviews.t: YOU ALWAYS NEED TWEEZERS! Tweezers seem to be the ...
reviews.x: YOU ALWAYS NEED TWEEZERS!  Tweezers seem to be the thing that always walk off on their own and you never see them again. I was looking for some replacement tweezers and stumbled upon this product. This product comes with a carrying case and you get three tweezers, with different types of tips. I feel this is a lot more functional than just having one type of tweezer. Also they tweezers are glittery! Very girly and cute. You cannot go wrong with this set.

These tweezers work well and come in a cute little case! I didn't know what to expect because they were inexpensive, but I am impressed with the overall quality. The only thing I would change is how well they grab smaller, shorter hairs. It sometimes takes me several tries in a magnifying mirror to get them to grab onto some of my straw brow hairs. They have to be completely cleaned off after each pluck or they will not remove another hair.

Cute set of tweezers for a woman.  Love the colors, and they work really well at getting those pesky, unwanted hairs plucked.  I use them on myself, and help out my husband with his unwanted hairs.  I also love that the set comes in a case as I always misplaced my old tweezers.  Easy to keep track of these.

These three pair of tweezers are both cute and functional. The three tips, pointed straight and angled are stainless steel and work well for tweeting hairs. They are glittery and cute and come in a nice case to keep them together.  I got these as a gift for my daughter and she loves them.

I love this set of tweezers.  I use the slanted end ones most often and they grab even the finest of hairs from my chinny  chin chin.  They come in a cute case so they're easy to find in my makeup bag.  I would definitely recommend  them and will be ordering a set for my daughter. !

I received these tweezers in excellent condition, well wrapped. Love the case they came in for keeping it together in my cavenous handbag and for traveling. There are Very professional looking and the powder coat is nice and helps with gripping them.

reviews.t: Best tweezers I have ever had!
reviews.x: Highest rating! Super fast! The case and tweezers are even nicer than in picture! Very well made and durable. Its really hard to find a decent pair of tweezera and this came with three! I would definitely buy from again and heartily recommend!

Great carrying case and cute! I love having three different options for tweezers. Hopefully I keep track of all of them and remember to put them back in the case. I bought the makeup organizer and have been keeping them in there. Great buy.

Love this cute little set of tweezers. There are 3 different type of tweezers- pointed tip, slant tip and flat. They are perfect for your eyebrows or whatever you choose to use them for. This is an awesome deal for 3 pairs of tweezers.

Good bargain for tweezers that work. Nicely painted (enameled) with thick coating. Tweezers sharp and precise. Carrying sleeve keeps the tweezers intact... They're hard to lose when the 3 are kept stored in the neat little sleeve.

Haven't actually used these yet, but I inspected the grip at the ends and they are very straight.  Material is hard and the hand grip is comfortable.  I don't know about longevity yet, but they seem sturdy.
Cute set of tweezers. And the storage pouch is great as well. I will less likely loose them like that. They are just as good as the ones you would buy for double the price.

reviews.t: Really GOOD set of tweezers- really GOOD price❣️
reviews.x: Really good tweezers, the whole set! Plus the leather pack keeps them together in one place in my purse. Love them! Will let you know if the paint peels;)
This is a great little set of tweezers, so sharp and high-quality! It comes with a very nice protective pouch. Very pleased.
Can't wait to use for placing tiny nail art but as many splinters as my kids seem to find, they'll get a good workout!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the set as great value and high quality for the low price.
Many reviewers love that the set includes three different tip types for different jobs.
The included carrying case is widely appreciated for keeping the tweezers together and easy to find.
Reviewers report the tweezers grab hairs well, including fine hairs, and close firmly without a gap.
A few reviewers note they struggle to grab smaller, shorter hairs.
